_comment: Physical calibration for the SBI multi-city leaf (204 x 92 mm, landscape). All field positions are millimetres from the leaf's top-left corner, before the 90-degree print rotation. Bump 'version' after changing any value: a version change makes every browser drop its saved per-field overrides and pick these up.
_hardware: The HP LaserJet Pro MFP M126nw PPD declares an ImageableArea inset of 11.9906pt = 4.23mm on all four edges. Nothing closer than ~4.3mm to any leaf edge will receive toner, so keep every field at or beyond 5mm from the edges. The A/C payee crossing is a deliberate exception: it is anchored inside that margin and its ends are accepted as clipped, since the two rules and the caption still fall in the printable middle.
_paper: 'exact' prints a custom 92x204mm page. 'a4' prints the same 92x204 block at 1:1 on an A4 sheet, offset by a4x/a4y millimetres from the sheet's top-left, for printers with no custom size.

fields._cross: Bounding box for the A/C payee crossing. x,y = top-left corner in mm. w,h = box size; the box's top and bottom borders ARE the two rules, so h is the gap between them. angle = tilt in degrees (negative tilts up to the right). origin = pivot corner, 'top left' or 'bottom left'. textDx = caption nudge in mm, negative moves it left. size = caption text height, tracking = letter spacing.
